title: x sin x and its antiderivative
caption: SymPy gives ∫ x sin x dx = sin x − x cos x. Differentiating that returns x sin x: the slope of the antiderivative curve at each x equals the height of x sin x, which is the quick check.
alt: The curve y = x sin x and its antiderivative y = sin x − x cos x, with the slope of the second at x = 2 equal to the height of the first.
description: Plot SymPy's antiderivative sin x − x cos x.
At x = 2 the antiderivative's slope equals f(2) = 2 sin 2.
That is the check: differentiate the result.

checks.name: the antiderivative's slope at x = 2 is 2 sin 2 = f(2)
and at x = 4 it is 4 sin 4 = f(4)
